scripts.dev:kill-port: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); const port=process.env.PORT||'3000'; const ps='powershell -NoProfile -Command \"$c=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort '+port+' -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($c){$c.OwningProcess}\"'; let out=''; try{ out=cp.execSync(ps,{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString().trim(); }catch(e){} if(!out){ console.log('No hay proceso escuchando en el puerto', port); process.exit(0);} const pids=out.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); for(const pid of pids){ try{ cp.execSync('TASKKILL.EXE /F /PID '+pid,{stdio:'ignore'}); console.log('Killed PID', pid, 'on port', port);}catch(e){ console.log('No pude matar PID', pid, e && e.message ? e.message : e);} }"
scripts.dev:fix: npm run dev:kill-port && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try{fs.rmSync('.next',{recursive:true,force:true});}catch(e){}" && npm run dev:stable
scripts.dev:reset: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); try{cp.execSync('TASKKILL.EXE //F //IM node.exe',{stdio:'ignore'});}catch(e){}" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='.next'; try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});}catch(e){}"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run dev:reset && npm run dev:stable
